technique_name: Explain the causes of the First World War
description: The First World War was caused by the interactions between multiple nations, which created a tense atmosphere of competition and distrust. The conflict began with the rise of militarism, which led the European countries to focus on gaining power and control. Nationalism was also a major factor, causing countries to place their own interests before that of any other. The strategic system of alliances that had been put in place by the Triple Entente and the Triple Alliance also contributed to this
